entries.en: Now we know what happened to the colonists.
According to these logs, Cerberus is the organization behind this atrocity, whoever they are.
This is justice. This man deserves to die. So, are you going to kill me or not?
Weren't you listening? He was part of a secret organization!
I don't know what Cerberus is, but they'll never let their operation become public!
This is the only way! Are you helping me, or are you killing me?
I-- I thought I was dead. Thank you. Here, for your trouble. I-- I don't think I'll ever forget that madman's face.
He'd clearly suffered. I have no idea why he chose to take it out on me.
He'd killed my colleagues. We worked on Akuze, studying thresher maws to detect them earlier.
He must have lost friends to an attack, then heard about our research and blamed us for failing.
Now, if you'll excuse me, I can't stand to be in here another moment.
You can't kill me! You don't know who you're dealing with!
He killed my whole unit. I have to take him down myself. It's the last thing I have to do.
Mr. Toombs... please... we had no choice!
It's... it's really over.
Don't tell me what I am! Nobody knows who I am! Those bastards took it all away!
They ran their tests until I screamed, until I cried. I couldn't remember my own name half the time.
I should be dead, like my unit. I'm nothing! Why am I too good to murder him?
Hadn't thought of it like that.
Okay. I'm no murderer. They couldn't make me one. Just as long as he goes to trial.
Maybe the screaming will stop now. I don't know.
It is for me.
They had to die. You get it, right? I had no choice. But it's okay now.
Now the scientists are just like my unit. No survivors.
Stay back! I've got no grief with you! All I want is this bastard!
Please! He's a madman!
Shut up! You don't get to lie! You don't...
Shepard? My god, Shepard, is that you?
They took me, Shepard. The scientists.
You can't prove any of this! This man is delusional!
See, they were running tests on the thresher maws. They let those things hit us just to watch and study.
It's Corporal! Corporal Toombs! You don't get to lie! Not today! Today it all comes out!
You don't understand. I don't want to kill anyone.
Want? What I want is my life back!
I-- I want to go to sleep without screaming in my dreams! I want the people who sent me to Akuze brought to justice!
But if I can't get that, I'll have to settle for killing the men who took my life away.
You fire, and there's a good chance my gun goes off. You'll be wiping your scientist friend off the walls.
You think I'm afraid to die? All that matters to me is killing the man who ruined my life.
We were on Akuze when the thresher maws hit. My entire unit was wiped out.
The thresher maws... the scientists were studying them. They let them hit our unit, just to watch!
I woke up in a holding cell. The scientists were delighted I'd survived. Now they had someone to run tests on.
You can't believe Toombs! He doesn't have any proof! I demand a fair trial!
He was there, you bastard! He knows the truth!
Ever had thresher maw acid in your veins? I have. They wanted to see what it would do.
They treated me like a lab animal. I only escaped because somebody destroyed Cerberus, their big organization.
They're part of some organization, Cerberus, that runs secret tests like this. They treated me like a lab animal.
This man deserves to die, Shepard. For you, for me, for everyone else in the unit. Are you with me?
Toombs, it doesn't have to be like this. This isn't the only way!
I can arrest him. He'll answer for his crimes in court.
If what you're saying is true, then pull that trigger. I won't stop you.
I can't let you murder him. I'm sorry.
I wish I could have saved him. He was obviously in pain.
I don't know what you did to him, but I don't think he chose you by accident.
Save the story for the jury. You're going to jail, doctor.
I didn't save you out of charity. You people need to be exposed. You're under arrest.
Corporal, if you kill him, you're a criminal. But I'm a Spectre. Nobody will question me.
If you really want to do this yourself, I won't stop you.
You did your job for your unit, Corporal. Now let me do mine. That's an order.
No, the last thing you have to do is keep going, to show these bastards who won.
You're better than this, Toombs. You're not like them.
